flags.text: Additional Credit Facilities Approved | Board approved availing additional credit facilities of ₹1,250 Crores with SBI for issuing Standby Letter of Credit for subsidiary Colombo Dockyard PLC. | The credit facility represents nearly 10% of annual revenue (about ₹12,840 crore) to support its Sri Lankan subsidiary.

Board Approves INR 10,000 Crore NCD Issuance | Sun Pharma's board approved issuing private placement non-convertible debentures up to INR 10,000 Crore and noted Director Gautam Doshi's resignation. | The INR 10,000 Crore NCD authorization represents over 16% of annual revenue, indicating significant potential balance sheet expansion.

Long-term credit rating upgraded to AA Stable | CARE Ratings upgraded the company's long-term rating to AA Stable, its highest-ever in credit history, reflecting disciplined capital management. | The upgrade covers bank facilities and debentures totaling Rs 25,749.96 crore, validating improved fiscal prudence and supporting core infrastructure expansion against annual revenue of about ₹111,432 crore.

September 2026 production volume numbers announced | Total production volume for September 2026 was 242,011 units compared to 201,915 units in September 2025. | Total production volume rose by about 19.9% year-on-year, driven by increases in both passenger vehicles and light commercial vehicles against an annual revenue of about ₹208,192 crore.

Approval of Rights Issue Up to ₹1,000 Crore | The board approved raising up to ₹1,000 crore through the issuance of partly paid-up equity shares via a rights issue. | The proposed ₹1,000 crore fund raise represents over 50% of the company's annual revenue of about ₹1,880 crore.
